description:
Make the project-defined preset integration fixture place its worktree and `.jit` data root inside its own `TempDir`, so concurrent tests never share the process-global temporary directory’s bootstrap lock.

## Background

The fixture currently constructs `JsonFileStorage` directly at `TempDir::path()` and then discovers the worktree as that path’s parent. Multiple nextest processes therefore resolve the same `$TMPDIR/.jit-bootstrap.lock`; matched concurrency runs reproduced five-second lock timeouts at both 24 and 48 workers. The preset behavior itself is correct, but its repository topology is not isolated.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Constructs every file-backed preset fixture with a unique worktree directory and a `.jit` data root beneath that worktree, never with the shared temporary-directory parent as its worktree.
- [hard] REQ-02: Preserves the existing save, list, show, apply, registry-event, and on-disk preset assertions without changing production lock behavior or timeouts.
- [hard] REQ-03: Adds a deterministic regression proving two concurrently created preset fixtures resolve distinct repository roots and can complete their real preset writes without bootstrap-lock contention.

## Notes

This is a test-fixture isolation repair. Do not weaken the bootstrap lock, increase its timeout, serialize the test target, or change nextest scheduling to mask the shared-root defect.
title: Isolate the project-defined preset fixture root
